d: Long, flowing ash-brown hair with choppy bangs and a single high ponytail. Pale grey, almond-shaped eyes with a calm expression. A youthful, adolescent face and a slender build. The outfit consists of a white and black sleeveless top with a black faux-fur collar, a grey pleated miniskirt with red straps, and asymmetrical red thigh-high stockings with black mechanical boots. Signature details include a black headset with red accents, a black fingerless glove on one hand, and a large futuristic sword with a glowing red blade.
